defects.what: Human faces grow out of the floating logs: a boy's head with no body sits among the logs and a half-buried face lies in the debris, in a shot meant to have nobody.
defects.where: top centre among the logs and bottom centre in the debris

defects.what: The Indio doubles are young boyish men with no red headband, no topknot and no grey hair, one with pink hair, so none reads as Indio.
defects.where: every rooftop figure, worst at bottom left (pink hair) and bottom right foreground

defects.what: The man lunging to save the child is a young man in a white shirt with no headband or topknot, while the next shot (k24) shows Indio holding the same child.
defects.where: right side, the man in the water

defects.what: The hug has too many arms: the child shows a purple sleeve and two grey sleeves, giving five hands between Indio and the child.
defects.where: lower half, the child's arms around Indio's chest and the hands under the child

defects.what: The hands of the blue-shirt man and the girls over the pink cloth fuse into one knot of fingers with no countable hands.
defects.where: centre, over the girl in the pink dress

defects.what: Three nurses are stacked into one body: a white-cap head, a grey-haired head with blue bows and a pink-scrubs back share one torso with extra waving hands.
The padlock and ring are a photo-real render, not the anime drawing of every other shot, so the cut jolts.
The front villager's hand on the bamboo pole is a boneless lump with no separate fingers.
defects.where: centre, under the front man's chin

defects.what: The man watching the floodgate is a young man with no headband, topknot or grey hair, but the line says Indio is the one watching.
defects.where: bottom right, the man in the green jacket

defects.what: The golden doubles are chibi kids with spiky hair holding guitars and swords, and the biggest ones have smeared, half-melted faces.
defects.where: centre and left, the large golden figures

defects.what: A shot meant to have nobody is filled with a crowd of mismatched anime characters, some with no face under their caps.
defects.where: lower half crowd, faceless heads at bottom left (brown cap) and right (white cap)

defects.what: Small street figures are smeared: a teal-hat child's face melts behind the pink girl, and a boy's legs tangle.
The volunteers in the truck beds are mushy, with tangled knees and arms and crude faces.
The helicopter has a searchlight and a red disc on stalks hanging from its belly and no landing skids.
A small red sign carries letter-like lines.
defects.where: left middle, below the bronze dome

defects.what: The scaly hands are malformed: the upper one shows only two fingers and a thumb, and on the lower one the little finger grows from the heel of the palm.
defects.third_reader: The scaly hands are gone, but the new fish-creature has two eyes on the same side of its head (a small fish eye on the snout and a large anime eye below), a new face fault as visible as the old one. -> redrawn again (siyokoy from behind with no face; arms crossed inside both sleeves; full body with legs) and checked at 3x.

defects.what: Usman has two folded ears instead of one.
The hand on the yoke is a lumpy mass of knuckles, and Sinag's white cuff fuses into Indio's green sleeve.
The helicopter pilot's seat has a car steering wheel, and a daytime desert shows through the window in a night scene.
The power drills have no pistol grips or handles, only tubes with chucks.
The carried nipa hut is only a haystack-like thatch roof on poles, with no walls or floor.
A faceless bald head presses into the grey-haired woman, with an extra hand on her shoulder.
At the left end of the carried house, a tangle of planks and people climbs out of the house wall.
defects.where: top, the distant house, left end

defects.what: The fist with the white cloth is a mitten-like lump with no separate fingers.
defects.third_reader: The mitten fist is gone, but Indio's bare forearm with the cloth now grows straight out of the jacket's zipper front with no sleeve, a limb from the wrong place. -> redrawn again (siyokoy from behind with no face; arms crossed inside both sleeves; full body with legs) and checked at 3x.

defects.what: The kapre is a black wolf or bear beast rather than a hairy tree giant, and an unscripted boy sits under it.
defects.where: right, the beast and the boy on the log

defects.what: Letter-like marks are stamped on the key head.
Usman has two folded ears and a stocky, pup-like face.
defects.third_reader: Usman now has one folded ear, but Indio has no legs: below his jacket hem there is only a grey smeared patch of concrete, and he reads younger with no grey hair. -> redrawn again (siyokoy from behind with no face; arms crossed inside both sleeves; full body with legs) and checked at 3x.

defects.what: Indio's open hand holding the keys has too many digits: fingers fan out up, left and down-left plus a curled finger and a thumb, about six in all, and the palm runs into his chin.
defects.where: left half, the hand in front of his face

defects.what: A sign on the hospital building carries letter-like marks.
defects.where: upper right, on the building wall left of the tail rotor
